name: Lunar lander (bench)
notes: Two sequential bench checks on one continuous timeline (no reset between them — intentional). Free fall for 1.5 s under lunar gravity must give vy ~= -2.43 m/s and altitude ~398 m with fuel untouched; then full thrust for 0.5 s must burn fuel. Tests force application, state management and the BENCH contract; playability/visuals are for the blind vote.
